title: Instanton Interactions and the Axion Weak Gravity Conjecture
summary: The Weak Gravity Conjecture admits a formulation in terms of long-range charged particle self-interactions being repulsive. We adopt a similar approach to the Axionic Weak Gravity Conjecture by considering long-range instanton interactions. At leading order, in the instanton separation, such interactions are mediated purely by massless scalar fields. Gravitational and gauge interactions are sub-leading.
